Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Something sleeps under this island that undoes what is made. Knots slip. Walls slump. Fires forget to burn.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: The first weavers couldn't kill it. They tied it down with four knots: stone, fire, tide and wind.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: The knots are crystals. Four towers on the shore held them, until the old keepers carried them off and hid them.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: {role.rival_leader.name} of the Ash Clan wants them for his altars. We bring them home first.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: These six have said they'll come. I'd trust any of them with my back.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: If I lose a duel out there, one of them stays behind so the rest of us get out. I won't pretend otherwise.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Want a practice duel first? Nobody gets hurt in practice.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Come with me?

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Hidden, the crystals still hold, but loosely. What leaks out is what the camps call demons.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: An altar isn't a tower. A crystal on an Ash altar is a knot half untied.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: What is it?

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: This is its tower. Shall I set it?

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Then {volunteer.name} holds the way out and doesn't come back. The rest of us live to try again.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: There's nobody left to hold the way out. If I lose this one, it's over.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: {count.restored} of four towers lit. {count.alive} of the six still with us.

Lines.Speaker: garrick
Lines.Text: Somebody has to be last out of a bad place. I've had the practice.

Lines.Speaker: ivo
Lines.Text: I draw the way in so I can find the way out. Mostly for me.

Lines.Speaker: petra
Lines.Text: Fire tells you what it wants. People are harder.

Lines.Speaker: nell
Lines.Text: The tide keeps its promises. It's the only thing that does.

Lines.Speaker: odo
Lines.Text: Every cut on a tree is somebody saying something. I just listen.

Lines.Speaker: tansy
Lines.Text: I'll be back before you've finished worrying.
Carved over the door: stone holds stone. This tower keeps {crystal.earth.name}.
Carved over the door: fire calls fire. This tower keeps {crystal.fire.name}.
Carved over the door: the tide comes home. This tower keeps {crystal.water.name}.
Carved over the door: wind finds its way. This tower keeps {crystal.air.name}.

Lines.Speaker: prince
Lines.Text: The camps will keep. Go and find your crystals.

Lines.Speaker: prince
Lines.Text: One tower burning again. The demons came less often this week.

Lines.Speaker: prince
Lines.Text: Two towers lit. The old folk say they slept through the night for once.

Lines.Speaker: prince
Lines.Text: Three towers. One more and we can stop counting the demons.

Lines.Speaker: prince
Lines.Text: All four towers burn. Whatever sleeps under us is tied down tight.
Coming
Go down

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: This way! Keep up.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: I'm going on. Catch me up when you can.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Not that way, then. Let me think.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: It's the best lead we have.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Go, then. I'll leave word of where I am.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Good. Stay close.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: You found me. Are you with me?

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Not yet, then. We step back and breathe.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Wait for {companion.tansy.name}. I won't fight with one of us still out there.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: It will keep. Tell me when.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Back! Back the way we came!

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Neither Ward broke. Back, and we try again.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: That wasn't it. We lost time.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Nothing more to chase just now. We wait for word.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: The way out is lit. Follow the light.
You fell behind. Mira has gone on without you.
The map (Tab) shows where Mira is. Find her and tap her to rejoin.
fell here, holding the way out.

Lines.Speaker: ivo
Lines.Text: Take the map. I drew the way out for you, not for me.

Lines.Speaker: petra
Lines.Text: Go. I'll give them something hotter to think about.

Lines.Speaker: nell
Lines.Text: Run. I'll hold them the way the tide holds a boat.

Lines.Speaker: odo
Lines.Text: Go on. A tree doesn't move for a storm, and nor will I.

Lines.Speaker: tansy
Lines.Text: I'm the fastest of us. That's why I'm last. Go!

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Ivo drew us the way out and stayed at the top of it.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Petra stood in that gap like it was her father's forge door.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: The tide keeps its promises, Nell said. So did she.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Odo stood like one of his trees. We got out because of him.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Tansy was always back before we finished worrying. Not this time.
